followup.title: Result ready · choose the next action
followup.explanation: This deliverable is completed. Follow-up work has not started merely because the result was accepted. Review and authorize a separate, scoped task below.
followup.scopeHint: Copy the concrete step from the result and add the needed context. This task receives your instructions below, not the full previous document automatically.
followup.briefPrefix: Founder-authorized follow-up to this completed task (reference only; execute only the explicit instructions below):
followup.acceptance: Deliver the specified result with actual evidence. Keep the $0 additional-spend limit and current role/tool permissions. Report missing prerequisites and the next remedy; do not claim unperformed actions.
followup.supported: Approval queues a real task for Steve to assign. The current host supports planning, drafting and permitted native research; it cannot publish campaigns, contact customers, install software or deploy products. Approval does not add those capabilities.
followup.updated: The source result changed. Cancel and review its current version before approving.
